# API Contract & Behavior Checklist: Cursor-Based Pagination for Bookmarks

**Purpose**: Validate that API contract and behavior requirements are complete, clear, and unambiguous before planning
**Created**: 2026-03-24
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md)

**Note**: This checklist is generated by the `/speckit.checklist` command based on feature context and requirements.

## Requirement Completeness

- [ ] CHK001 - Are the exact query parameter names for cursor and page size specified (e.g., `cursor`, `page_size`, `limit`)? [Gap — FR-005, FR-006 say "accept a parameter" but don't name it]
- [ ] CHK002 - Is the paginated response envelope fully specified with exact field names (e.g., `bookmarks`, `next_cursor`, `prev_cursor`, `total`, `page_size`)? [Gap — Paginated Result entity describes fields conceptually but not the exact shape]
- [ ] CHK003 - Are error response formats specified for invalid cursor (FR-014) and invalid page size (FR-015) — status code, error body structure, error message content? [Gap]
- [ ] CHK004 - Is the behavior specified when both a cursor and conflicting filters are provided (e.g., cursor from tag=design used with tag=dev)? [Gap — FR-012 covers filter+pagination but not filter-change-mid-cursor]
- [ ] CHK005 - Are requirements defined for how the "previous" cursor behaves on the first page (null, absent, or empty string)? [Completeness, FR-004]
- [ ] CHK006 - Are requirements defined for how the "next" cursor behaves on the last page (null, absent, or empty string)? [Completeness, FR-003]

## Requirement Clarity

- [ ] CHK007 - Is "clear error message" quantified with specific error codes or message formats for FR-014 and FR-015? [Clarity — "clear error" is vague]
- [ ] CHK008 - Is the distinction between "next cursor" and "previous cursor" parameters clearly defined — are they separate parameters or a single cursor with directional semantics? [Clarity, FR-005]
- [ ] CHK009 - Is "caps the page size at the maximum" (User Story 2, scenario 4) clearly specified — should the system silently cap or return a warning? [Clarity, FR-008]
- [ ] CHK010 - Is "invalid cursor value" (FR-014) defined — does it cover malformed encoding, expired/stale cursors, or cursors referencing deleted bookmarks? [Clarity]

## Requirement Consistency

- [ ] CHK011 - Are the total count semantics consistent — does FR-010 mean total matching items across all pages, or total items on the current page? [Consistency — entity definition says "total count of matching items" but FR-010 is slightly ambiguous]
- [ ] CHK012 - Is the page size capping behavior (User Story 2, scenario 4) consistent with FR-015 which says "reject" invalid values — is exceeding max an error or a silent cap? [Conflict, FR-008 vs FR-015]
- [ ] CHK013 - Is the response format assumption (always paginated envelope, Clarifications §Session) reflected in FR-001 through FR-010, or only in Assumptions? [Consistency — requirement should be in FR section, not just Assumptions]

## Scenario Coverage

- [ ] CHK014 - Are requirements specified for the response when the cursor points to a bookmark that has been deleted since the cursor was issued? [Coverage, Edge Case]
- [ ] CHK015 - Are requirements specified for what happens when page_size changes between paginated requests (e.g., page 1 with size=10, then cursor for page 2 with size=20)? [Coverage, Gap]
- [ ] CHK016 - Are requirements specified for simultaneous use of both next and previous cursor parameters in a single request? [Coverage, Edge Case]
- [ ] CHK017 - Are requirements defined for the first request (no cursor) — is this implicitly "page 1" or must a specific parameter signal "start from beginning"? [Coverage, FR-005]

## Acceptance Criteria Quality

- [ ] CHK018 - Can SC-002 ("no duplicate or missing bookmarks") be objectively measured without knowing the cursor implementation? [Measurability, SC-002]
- [ ] CHK019 - Is SC-001 ("under 1 second...up to 10,000 bookmarks") testable given no performance testing infrastructure is defined in the spec? [Measurability, SC-001]
- [ ] CHK020 - Does SC-005 ("fewer than 20 bookmarks sees no change") define what "no change" means given the response format is always the paginated envelope now? [Clarity, SC-005 vs Clarifications §Session]
